manifest.title: Import high-value ECC agents
manifest.description: Import six high-value portable agents from Everything Claude Code, adapt them to the local VS Code agent contract, and synchronize the authoritative inventory surfaces.

repo_structure.reason: New agent definitions are added here using the local .agent.md contract.
Authoritative inventory and roadmap must reflect the imported agents.
Always-on agent inventory must stay aligned with what actually exists.
Manifest persistence for the approved orchestration record.

assumptions.description: Keep canonical ECC agent names unless a local VS Code constraint makes a rename materially better.
Adapt imported agents to the established local frontmatter contract using target/model/tools rather than raw ECC tool declarations.

uncertainties.description: The ECC e2e-runner assumes Agent Browser as the primary execution surface, which is not a native dependency of this workspace.
uncertainties.impact: Medium risk of mismatched guidance if imported verbatim.
uncertainties.mitigation: Rewrite the execution guidance around the local browser and Playwright-capable VS Code tool surface while preserving the testing intent.

uncertainties.description: The database-reviewer agent is PostgreSQL-specific and may need scope wording that clarifies its intended use in this language-agnostic workflow repo.
uncertainties.mitigation: Keep the canonical name and explicitly describe the specialization in the agent description.
